outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command: sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".schema words" ".schema senses" ".schema synsets"; echo "--- sample ---"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT * FROM senses LIMIT 5; SELECT * FROM words LIMIT 5; SELECT * FROM synsets LIMIT 5;"

sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite ".indexes"; echo "---counts---"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT 'words',COUNT(*) FROM words UNION ALL SELECT 'senses',COUNT(*) FROM senses UNION ALL SELECT 'synsets',COUNT(*) FROM synsets;"; echo "---query plan---"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /app/my-sql-query.sql)"

sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT synsetid) FROM synsets; SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT wordid) FROM words; SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT senseid) FROM senses; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid, synsetid FROM senses GROUP BY wordid, synsetid HAVING COUNT(*)>1) ; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT wordid, word FROM words GROUP BY wordid, word HAVING COUNT(*)>1);"

time sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "$(cat /app/my-sql-query.sql)" > /tmp/orig.out; wc -l /tmp/orig.out; head -5 /tmp/orig.out; echo "---"; sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "SELECT MAX(c), MIN(c) FROM (SELECT wordid, COUNT(*) c FROM senses GROUP BY wordid);"

cat > /tmp/candA.sql <<'EOF'
WITH ws AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.wordid, s.synsetid, COUNT(*) AS cnt, syn.domainid, syn.posid
  FROM senses s
  JOIN synsets syn ON syn.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid, syn.domainid, syn.posid
),
stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT wordid,
         COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
         SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
         COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
         COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM ws
  GROUP BY wordid
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2
     AND SUM(cnt) >= 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT wordid, synsetid, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM ws
)
SELECT w.wordid AS word_id,
       w.word AS word,
       st.total_synsets,
       st.total_senses,
       st.distinct_domains,
       st.distinct_posids,
       r.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
       r.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM stats st
JOIN words w ON w.wordid = st.wordid
JOIN ranked r ON r.wordid = st.wordid AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY st.total_senses DESC,
         st.total_synsets DESC,
         st.distinct_domains DESC,
         w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 500;
EOF
time sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite < /tmp/candA.sql > /tmp/A.out
diff /tmp/A.out /tmp/orig.out && echo MATCH
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite "EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN $(cat /tmp/candA.sql)"

cp /tmp/candA.sql /app/sol.sql
cat /app/sol.sql
echo "--- validation ---"
sqlite3 /app/oewn.sqlite < /app/sol.sql > /tmp/sol.out
diff /tmp/sol.out /tmp/orig.out && echo "OUTPUT MATCHES ORIGINAL"
